page.overview:
What is Void Century?

The Void Century, also known as the , is a century-long time period from 900 to 800 years prior to the current storyline with no recorded archaeological history. For unknown reasons, research into this era is considered to be the worst crime possible by the World Government. The events of this period are so important and relevant that by learning them, one is said to become aware of the "true history" of the Blue Planet.

It is Nico Robin's dream to uncover the truth of the Void Century by discovering the "Rio Poneglyph". Following his death, the scientist Dr. Vegapunk revealed to the world via a pre-planned broadcast what he knew about the Void Century, although part of it was temporarily interrupted by the Five Elders' desperate attempt to stop the broadcast at all costs.

This period became known as the Void Century because there is nothing left to acknowledge anything that happened during that time. The only exception are the Poneglyphs, which are written in an ancient language that only a few people in modern times know how to read: Nico Robin, the archaeologists of Ohara, Kouzuki Sukiyaki, and Vegapunk. Among these people, only Robin and Sukiyaki are still alive today, as it is unknown if any of Vegapunk's satellites have this ability.

However, it causes a problem with the known histories of the world, as nothing ties up because of that missing period. Though many seem to know there is a gap in the historical record, virtually everyone is unaware that filling in this gap is possible. For example, Nefertari Cobra, after being told by Robin about this missing period, was completely shocked that a way to "tie the threads of history together" existed. The fact that filling the gap is possible was proven when "Dark King" Silvers Rayleigh revealed that the Roger Pirates discovered the true history.
